articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") has named Elizabeth Adler Treasury Management Sales Officer for the New Orleans market. "We are excited to have Elizabeth on the Treasury Management Sales team in New Orleans," said Tony Adams, Gulf States Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "Her commitment to building strong relationships and delivering exceptional service will enhance how we serve our clients and communities across the region." "Elizabeth has a strong understanding of the financial needs of businesses within this market and knows how to translate those needs into customized solutions," said Marcy Sasser, Senior Vice President of Treasury Management for Louisiana at First Horizon Bank. "Her collaborative approach and dedication to service excellence are an ideal fit for this role." Adler brings more than 30 years of banking and financial services experience to her new role.
